name: craq-sim
platform_scope: craq-sim (tt-blaze craq-sim, branch quasar @b702fd90, 2026-10-24): DM RISC-V at 1 instr/cycle, Tensix instruction timing incl. busy-status waits; NO NoC/DRAM transfer timing, barriers pre-satisfied, no contention, so l1/dram placements predict the same. Times are simulator cycles reported as ns (1 cycle = 1 ns by convention), not silicon.

calibration.method: qperf.calibration.fit: coordinate descent, mean squared log(pred/meas)

clock.note: 1 cycle reported as 1 ns so that ns == cycles; not a hardware clock

assumptions: costs are simulator cycles from the device profiler KERNEL zones (per-cluster span = first kernel start to last kernel end)
noc latency 0 and unlimited bandwidth: the simulator copies at issue (RES 10.x)
